- [ ] Relevant automated tests passed (include run URLs or command/output)

- [ ] Public / internal / confidential / secret classification completed for added logs/screenshots/commits

- [ ] Licensing/third-party attribution checked
- [ ] README, ROADMAP, milestone/Project fields, masterplan, ADR, session state and version docs synchronized **where applicable**

- [ ] Review conversations resolved

If a category is not applicable, explain why instead of implying it passed.

## Evidence

Links to test runs, screenshots (redacted), upstream provenance and supporting documents.
